video.description: Upload ID of the video, from POST /v1/uploads, in the same project.

range.title: HandPoseRange
range.description: Seconds of the video to process. Frames with start_s <= frame_index / fps < end_s are processed. end_s must be greater than start_s, and end_s beyond the video is clipped to its end (both checked by the service). Omitted: the whole video. Not processed yet: a run that sends a range is refused with 422 input_invalid until the model engine supports ranges.
